title: Jio Platforms adds $36B in market value in two trading sessions, hitting a $144B market cap, up from its ~$108B IPO valuation, after India's biggest-ever IPO (Ashutosh Joshi/Bloomberg)
summary: Ashutosh Joshi / Bloomberg: Jio Platforms adds $36B in market value in two trading sessions, hitting a $144B market cap, up from its ~$108B IPO valuation, after India's biggest-ever IPO — Jio Platforms Ltd. has added almost $36 billion in market value in two trading sessions, extending its blistering run …
